moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio elastic-scale, written here): Circle scales about its centre by keys: 0.1 → 1.2 at 405 ms (power2.out) → 0.92 at 612 → 1.06 at 756 → 1 at 900 ms (sine.inOut between keys): an elastic.out look with shrinking rebounds. The curve graph is a guide. Site exit: shrink to 0.5 + fade, 250 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.9 s) · from (0.1) · keys: các đỉnh nảy (1.2 / 0.92 / 1.06).
